full_judgment: 3. The facts as figured in the plaint, are that, the defendants as owner of the schedule property covered by SA Khatian Nos. 70 and 584, measuring 13 decimals sold the same to the plaintiffs at a consideration of Taka 3,000 and accordingly, the defendants executed a sale deed on 30-10-1997 in favour of the plaintiffs with a promise that they will register the deed later on. The defendants on this and that plea took time and ultimately refused to give registration of the sale deed executed by them. The plaintiffs then, once again requested them and finally served a legal notice upon the defendants on 12-7-1988 demanding registration of the sale deed but the defendants did not come forward to register the sale deed executed by them. Consequently, the plaintiffs finding no way out have constrained to file the present suit praying for a direction upon the defendants to register the deed executed in favour of the plaintiffs.
